title: The JASONs solve DoD problems in summer studies

tellings.quote: They're supposed to solve problems that the DoD gives to them.

plain: A scientist who has worked for the Pentagon, Eric Davis, describes a group called the JASONs, a panel of scientists who advise the US Department of Defense. According to Davis, they meet in summer studies and are supposed to solve problems the Defense Department hands them, which would mean outside experts are quietly brought in on hard military questions.
